subject: Heathcliff
text: The final battle against Heathcliff on the 100th Floor is fought with only Kirito and his chosen partner.

evidence.quote: キリトの私闘のため、[パートナー](//w.atwiki.jp/sao-im/pages/58.html "パートナー \(4656d\)")と二人だけで戦う。某究極幻想のⅦやⅩの様なイベント戦に見えるが、ガチバトルなので心してかかろう。
evidence.translation: Due to Kirito's private duel, you fight with only your partner as a duo. It looks like an event battle like in a certain Ultimate Fantasy VII or X, but it is a serious battle so prepare yourself.

subject: Heathcliff
text: Heathcliff is the only enemy that actively uses shield defense to halve damage, so attack with high-hit-count skills rather than high single-hit power.

evidence.quote: 最大の脅威はエネミーで唯一盾防御スキルが機能していること。ダメージ数値を見ていると、かなりの確率で与ダメを半減されているのがわかる。...また、盾防御への対策に威力よりも手数で攻める技を選ぶといいだろう。
evidence.translation: The greatest threat is that he is the only enemy whose shield defense skill functions. Looking at damage numbers, dealt damage is halved with high probability....Also, as a countermeasure against shield defense, choose skills that attack with hit count rather than raw power.

subject: Heathcliff
text: Parrying is particularly effective against Heathcliff to inflict Risk Break, especially on his frequently used Unicorn Charge after his backstep.

evidence.quote: 特にパリングが有用でリスクブレイクさせやすい。多用するユニコーン・チャージはタイミングが計りやすい（バックステップの後にパリング発動）。
evidence.translation: Parrying is especially useful and makes it easy to cause Risk Break. His frequently used Unicorn Charge is easy to time (activate parrying after his backstep).

subject: Heathcliff
text: Heathcliff uses the ultimate skill Akashic Armageddon when his HP is at 20% or lower, which cannot be parried and must be interrupted with Throat or Bash.

evidence.quote: ただし、瀕死（HP20％以下？）で使いだすアカシック・アーマゲドンは奥義技なのでパリング不能。威力も絶大なのでスロートやバッシュで確実に中断させること。
evidence.translation: However, Akashic Armageddon, which he begins using when near death (HP 20% or less?), is an ultimate skill and cannot be parried. Its power is tremendous, so interrupt it reliably with Throat or Bash.

subject: Heathcliff
text: Defense Call and Danger Avoidance commands bolster defense during the battle because their effects do not expire regardless of actions taken during their duration.

evidence.quote: ディフェンスコールや危険回避の指示など、制限時間中は何やっても効果の切れないスキルで防御の底上げもいい。
evidence.translation: It is also good to bolster defense with skills whose effects do not expire no matter what you do during their time limit, such as Defense Call or Danger Avoidance orders.

subject: Heathcliff
text: Divine Cross is used by Heathcliff from the start of the battle, executing a downward slash into a horizontal slash cross-cut with very fast initial attack startup.

evidence.quote: ディバイン・クロス | 最初から使用 | 斬り下げ→水平斬りの十字斬。発動から初撃が非常に短い
evidence.translation: Divine Cross | Used from the start | Downward slash to horizontal slash cross cut. Startup to the first hit is extremely short

subject: Heathcliff
text: Gospel Square is used by Heathcliff after his HP is halved, performing a four-hit vertical diamond-shaped slash.

evidence.quote: ゴスペル・スクエア | HP半減？ | 垂直に◇型を描く四連斬
evidence.translation: Gospel Square | HP halved? | Vertical diamond-shaped four-hit slash

subject: Heathcliff
text: When Heathcliff activates Parrying, his counterattack can be avoided by executing any skill immediately after.

evidence.quote: Skill | パリング | 最初から | 発動後に何かスキルの使用で反撃を回避可
evidence.translation: Skill | Parrying | From the start | Counterattack can be avoided by using any skill after activation

subject: Heathcliff
text: Heathcliff uses Perfection Style when his HP is reduced to half, requiring caution from evasion-focused Kirito builds.

evidence.quote: パーフェクションスタイル | HP半減？ | キリトを回避型に育てている人は警戒の必要あり
evidence.translation: Perfection Style | HP halved? | Those who raised Kirito as an evasion-type need to be on guard

subject: Klein
text: Raising Furinkazan to the top guild allows Klein to participate in boss conquest battles even when not selected as Kirito's partner.

evidence.quote: 風林火山をトップギルドに育てておけば、ボス攻略時にパートナーに選んでなくてもクラインが参戦します。...しっかり育てておけば強力なソードスキルを連発してくれます。
evidence.translation: If you raise Furinkazan to the top guild, Klein will participate in boss conquests even if you have not selected him as a partner....If raised properly, they will repeatedly use powerful sword skills.

subject: Boss
text: Against sword-wielding bosses, parrying or Exact Onslaught creates openings, and repeatedly commanding the partner to use skills will stun-lock the boss so arcane skills can be used from afar.

evidence.quote: 剣士系のボスなら予備動作が大きいから「パリング」「エグザクトオンスロート」を使ってスキを作って...パートナーに「スキルを使え」を命令しまくっていればボスが動かない
evidence.translation: Against sword-wielding bosses, their startup is large, so use Parrying or Exact Onslaught to create openings...if you keep ordering your partner to use skills, the boss will not move

subject: NM Blazer Demon
text: The NM Blazer Demon on the 81st Floor is located inside the front-left ruin among the 4 ruins.

evidence.quote: ブレイザーデーモンは＊4つの遺跡のうちの左手前のやつの中にいる＊
evidence.translation: Blazer Demon is inside the front-left ruin among the 4 ruins

subject: Hollow
text: In the 3rd battle of the final boss sequence, Klein dying triggers an immediate Game Over, while Hollow's party-wide attacks can be canceled with interrupt skills like Throat and hand attacks parried when raised.

evidence.quote: 3戦目積んでいた方へ...ホロウ系の全体攻撃はスロートなどの中断系スキルで妨害し、手を使った攻撃は手を振り上げた瞬間に...パリィで妨害すると殆ど攻撃を食らわずに行けます...ちなみにクライン死亡は普通にゲームオーバーです
evidence.translation: For those stuck on the 3rd battle...interrupt Hollow-type party-wide attacks with interrupt skills like Throat, and hand attacks can be parried right as the hand raises to take almost no hits...by the way, Klein dying is a normal Game Over

subject: Heathcliff
text: Heathcliff can be easily defeated by remaining outside his effective range and repeatedly firing The Eclipse.

evidence.quote: ヒースクリフは基本も何も、効果範囲外を逃げ回りながらジ・イクリプス連発すれば余裕だった
evidence.translation: For Heathcliff, forget the basics; running around outside his effective range while repeatedly using The Eclipse made it easy
